exercise.title: The Do to Sol run, four notes a beat
exercise.why: A run stays in tune when it is fast once each note is in tune slow, so the five notes from Do to Sol at four a beat train the speed alone.

cells.text: Press Play below to hear the run: the mic starts with it. Sing along on "ah": from Do up to Sol and back, twice round, four notes per beat. Each pass starts a semitone higher. Notice which notes stay clear at this speed, and change to "oo" when it gets high.
